## Contract review

Reviewed at 2026-10-26T19:13Z — by an isolated contract-review subagent of the seat session, an agent other than the drafting os-dev subagent; read-only, on an adversarial brief.

Served-tier: `CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`
Head-sha: `ff37d61c1e54c537708fdbbecf8cd4e60e247f93`
Local-runs: none
Scope: .claude/agents/os-dev.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/cross-repo-coordination.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/execution-duties.md + .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/SKILL.md, .claude/skills/pm-dispatch/references/filing-gate.md, scripts/pm/check-skill-line-ratchet.mjs, scripts/pm/post-stamped.mjs

Inputs read, and nothing else: card #26121 body and its three comments (6416677493 triage first grade, 6424066785 the seat's claim, 6424729285 the os-dev-report; all three by objectstack-fleet[bot] — seat statements and a dev report, not authority; the maintainer's words are the verbatim quotes in the card body); precedent cards #26108 and #26110 (labels and body shape); the PR object, file list and diff; the cited files on origin/main and on the head via git show (origin/main at 2409c9c8 has not touched any cited file or script since merge-base e05e0de8, so the net diff against main is the same three-file +4/−3 diff); the CEILINGS rows and MAX_LINE_BYTES of the ratchet script; the vacant-ledger recogniser in post-stamped; the head's check-runs, read three times until none was in progress. The dispatch order and the dispatching seat's conclusions were not inputs. Face: `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` is in the file list (the dev-agent definition, clause ① protocol semantics) and all three paths are governed `.claude/**` — the rules face, CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER.

### ① Derived judgments

Maintainer's words, verbatim from the card body: 「需要转给 cloud的，应该立 cloud 车道卡」「需要转给 cloud的，应该立 cloud 车道卡，应该立卡写入 skills」「开发中涉及 cloud 车道的，也应该转给 cloud」. Triage shape (comment 6416677493): one home in `cross-repo-coordination.md`, pointers from `os-dev.md` and `execution-duties.md`. Every rule the diff adds, removes, narrows or respells, judged:

**(a) The home says the rule — right.** Head L46 「开发中涉 cloud 车道者由席位同拆:报告 `open_questions`/`out_of_scope_findings`、复核/落地所见。」 and L47 「⛔ 不记而弃、不并入本仓 PR、不留 `carrier: none`;停放卡加 `repo:cloud`,出处行与一行判据。」 sit directly under the split pair — L44 「跨不可达仓的卡立卡或首触按仓拆:该仓部分由可达席立卡,或挂 `domain:cloud`+`status:parked`。」 and L45 「本卡只留本仓活,不读他仓;拆不开先立该仓前置卡;依赖即 `pm:blocked`+`Blocked-by: owner/repo#N`。」.
- 同拆 binds to 按仓拆 two lines up: it is the only split named in the file's closing block, and the pair is placed so a cold reader meets L44–45 first. Under the other reading (同 = at the same time) the actor and the act are the same. Readable.
- Actor: 由席位 — the seat, not the dev, consistent with os-dev.md L54 (dev ⛔ 不查重…不立卡) and SKILL.md L283 「dev 不立卡」. The sources enumerated are exactly the card's three: the report's `open_questions` / `out_of_scope_findings`, and 复核/落地所见 (seat findings at review or landing).
- Shape: 停放卡 is the L44 parked card (`domain:cloud`+`status:parked`); L47 adds `repo:cloud`, a provenance line and one criterion. That is the precedents' shape: #26108 and #26110 carry `status:parked`, `repo:cloud`, `domain:cloud`, an Origin line and a Done-when line. On L44's other route (可达席立卡 in cloud) provenance and criterion come from L41 (转移落对方队列:…出处行与一行可执行判据,依赖用 `Blocked-by:`). Both routes match live practice: triage filed directly in cloud (comment 6416677493), the server seat parked here.
- The `Blocked-by:` half is carried by reference: 同拆 inherits L45 (本卡只留本仓活; 依赖即 `pm:blocked`+`Blocked-by:`), the line directly above the pair. Thin, but nothing is lost: the card body's sentence is L45 plus L46 read together.
- L47's three ⛔ are the card's three failure modes (noted-and-dropped, folded into the objectstack PR, left as a `carrier: none` line). A dev's `carrier: cloud` left unfiled by the seat is 记而弃, so it is forbidden too.

**(b) The retired intro line — a legitimate payment, no content loss (ii).** Old L3 「分诊席每次 fire 路由与查重前读本文;执行席跨仓认领、派发或转移时读本文。」 (103 B) and blank L4 were deleted to pay the two home lines: the file's CEILINGS row is 47 (its comment: lowered 51 → 47 when objectui stopped being a sister repo), so headroom was 0.
- Home of the reader-and-moment: SKILL.md L84 「| `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` | 分诊席路由与查重前;执行席跨仓认领、派发或转移时 | 多仓协调 |」 — same readers, same moments; 每次 fire is the table's column header 「谁在哪个 fire 读」. SKILL.md L42 names that index as where readers live: 「阶段文件与各自读者见〈阶段细则索引〉」.
- Precedent: three sibling references on origin/main already open with no reader line (`execution-duties.md`, `filing-gate.md`, `seat-lifecycle.md`); the others open with a reader line or a 「见 X;本文只放…」 pointer. No gate or recogniser pins the line: a whole-tree grep for its text hits only the file itself; `check:skill-frame-sync` judges the escalation decision frame, `check-skill-line-ratchet` counts lines and table-row bytes, `check:pm-skill-id-lint` scans for issue numbers, and all three ran green on the head.
- The review-time reader: the seat at 复核 now reaches the home through execution-duties.md L178, and SKILL.md L84 does not name that moment. That is an index-completeness observation, not a content loss — the rule has one home and the reader is routed. Per filing-gate.md L18 (协议观察…进座位贴或收班简报) it is the seat's 收班简报 item, ⛔ not a card and not a defect of this PR. Measured for the seat: L84 is a table row, 131 B on main, exempt from `MAX_LINE_BYTES` and pinned by `MAX_TABLE_ROW_BYTES` at 341 for SKILL.md, so a later in-place widening of that row costs no line and no pin.

**(c) The os-dev.md L52 respelling — four changes, none loses a rule.** Before: 「`carrier:` = 卡号或人,⛔ 非下个碰 X 的 PR;无则「承接者:无」;皆无 ⇒ 只进 Acceptance notes。」 (120 B). After: 「`carrier:` = 卡号或人,⛔ 非下个 PR;涉 cloud 写 `carrier: cloud`;无则 `none`;皆无只进该节。」 (114 B).
1. 「⛔ 非下个碰 X 的 PR」→「⛔ 非下个 PR」: the positive definition 卡号或人 is unchanged and already excludes every PR, an open sibling PR included — a sibling's carrier is its card number. The negative clause is illustrative and is now broader, in the same direction as the definition, so no dev behaviour changes. The full lesson stands for the seat on filing-gate.md L19 「「搭下个碰 X 的 PR」不算 `carrier:`」. Right. (Pre-existing and outside this diff: the JSON template at os-dev.md L379 still reads "carrier: PR or person", which already disagreed with 卡号或人 on main.)
2. 「无则「承接者:无」」→「无则 `none`」: the value a dev writes becomes `carrier: none` — the spelling the card body names, the spelling the home L47 forbids leaving (⛔ 不留 `carrier: none`), and the file's own idiom (`consumer: none`, L44). SKILL.md L282 keeps the gloss `carrier:`(承接者), so the Chinese label still maps. One spelling across home, dev side and card. Right.
3. New 「涉 cloud 写 `carrier: cloud`」: `cloud` is neither a card nor a person; the line grants it explicitly as a sentinel beside `none`, so a dev reading L52 cannot mistake it for a carrier that discharges anything. The line need not say who files — dev 不立卡 (L54, SKILL.md L283); the home L46 and the pointer L178 put the filing on the seat. It is the dev-side signal the maintainer's 「开发中涉及 cloud 车道的，也应该转给 cloud」 needs. Right.
4. 「皆无 ⇒ 只进 Acceptance notes」→「皆无只进该节」: 该节 resolves to L51's `## Acceptance notes`, the only section named in the bullet group (L51 names one report field and that section; L52 is its continuation). The seat-side twin SKILL.md L282 keeps 皆无 ⇒ Acceptance notes verbatim. Right.
Recogniser collision: none. post-stamped's `vacantLedgerRefusals` returns nothing unless `seatPostVacancy(body).vacant` — a body whose Current-PM section's first status token is ⏳ vacant (read in the function, not from the seat's claim). An os-dev-report comment has no Current-PM section, so it is never judged, whichever flag posts it. Its `Carrier:` key is case-sensitive (`Carrier|承接者?`, no i flag), so a lowercase `carrier: cloud` keys nothing even on a vacant body; a capitalised `Carrier: cloud` on a vacant ledger would be refused as naming no card, which is the rule's intent — by handover the seat has filed. The `next PR` key matches 下一个碰, not 下个 PR.

**(d) The execution-duties.md pointer — right place; extends, does not duplicate.** L178 「报告 `open_questions`/`out_of_scope_findings` 涉 cloud 车道者,按 `cross-repo-coordination.md` 立 cloud 卡。」 sits in the 复核 section directly after the review-checklist line, the step where the seat reads the report. SKILL.md L283 「三类由席位立在修复仓」 covers the three finding classes in the fix repo; L178 covers cloud-lane items of either report field (including `open_questions`, which are not findings) and routes them to the home — consistent with L283 because L44 lets the fix-repo part be filed by a reachable seat or parked here. 187 → 188, ceiling 188, headroom 0: the sibling card on review depth (not yet triaged) has no line of headroom left in this file; SKILL.md's headroom was 0 before and after this PR.

**(e) Ratchet and bytes, measured on the head tree.** Line counts origin/main → head: cross-repo-coordination.md 47 → 47 (ceiling 47), execution-duties.md 187 → 188 (188), os-dev.md 404 → 404 (404), SKILL.md 319 → 319 (319, untouched). New or respelled lines: 118 B, 118 B, 119 B, 114 B against `MAX_LINE_BYTES = 120`. The diff is exactly the four hunks — no re-wrap, no other line moved; the ratchet script is not in the file list, so no ceiling moved. `Lint & Repo Gates` success on the head (the ratchet and id-lint run in its `Lint · repo & tooling gates` lane, success), `Lint · PM dispatch-gates` success.

**(f) id-lint and grep.** No issue number in any added line (the precedents are named only in the PR body and the card). Case-insensitive `cloud` grep over `.claude/skills/pm-dispatch/**` and `os-dev.md`, counted by line: 20 on origin/main → 24 on the head. The dev's "21 → 24, three new hits" is off by one in its prose: four hit lines are new — the two home lines, the pointer, and the respelled os-dev.md L52, which carried no "cloud" before — and the dev's own enumeration of pre-existing hits lists 20. No pre-existing hit contradicts the new rule: SKILL.md L165 「`domain:cloud` | 云服务旅程,停放(加 `status:parked`,sweep 免扫)待 cloud PM 迁移,本仓不派」 describes exactly the parked state the home's L44 names and the precedents' bodies cite (「⛔ Not a claim; this repository does not dispatch it」); a development-time card parked here with `repo:cloud` is not dispatched and waits for the cloud PM, so 本仓不派 holds. The `mode:cloud` lines are the dispatch backend; the roster lines are repo names. One pre-existing tension, outside this diff and not widened by it: SKILL.md L170 「`domain:*` 只由分诊产出,两例外」 does not list the parked split, while the home's L44 (on main before this PR) already lets the splitting seat hang `domain:cloud`+`status:parked`, and both precedents did; for the seat's 收班简报.

### ② Semver level

`skip-changeset` is right: the file list is `.claude/**` only, nothing is published; `Check Changeset` success. `Clause-②: no` and `Metadata-protocol: none` on the PR body are right — no `packages/spec/src/**`, no metadata shape, no narrowing arm. The body carries `## 维护者速读(草稿)` with 席位意见 left empty, as the draft form requires. `Fixes #26121` is right — the card is the carrier of the maintainer's words and this PR is its whole scope (`Part-of PR must not also close its card` success).

### ③ Boundary flags

PR author: `user.login` is `objectstack-fleet[bot]`, read off the PR object (relay-written); no other login to name. Draft PR, mergeable_state blocked pending this record (`Governed Surface Queue Guard` success).

Dev flags, each answered:
- deviations — falsified ceiling hypothesis (47, not 51): confirmed from the CEILINGS row and its comment; the in-file payment is judged in ①(b). Answered.
- deviations — branch is the seat's harness push branch `claude/project-thread-1r3slx`, not claude/issue-N-slug: the claim comment names it as the measured platform exception; `The card this PR closes must claim this branch` success; two commits carrying the model-free trailer pair (`Claude-Session:` URL and `Co-authored-by: Claude`); no model identifier appears in any commit, comment or body (grep empty), so nothing `dispatch-gates --tier` printed reached GitHub. Answered.
- deviations — fleet-write's re-exec notice named the value of HTTPS_PROXY in the dev's local log: the dev did what os-dev.md L59 prescribes (named the variable only); no value reached the card, the PR body, the report or the commits (read). That a `scripts/pm/fleet-write` notice prints an environment value is a tooling observation on a `domain:skills` surface — escalated to the owning seat for its 收班简报, or a card at the seat's judgment; not a defect of this diff.
- deviations — worktree added on the existing local branch and fast-forwarded to origin/main, no `--no-track` / `-b`: the measured result is what rule 1 protects — a dedicated worktree, two commits rooted on then-main e05e0de8, a clean three-file diff, no shared-checkout edit; `No other open PR may claim the same single-writer path` success. Answered.
- deviations and out_of_scope_findings — SKILL.md L84 could name the review moment (carrier: the `domain:skills` seat): answered in ①(b) — a protocol observation for the seat's 收班简报 per filing-gate.md L18, not a card and not a FAIL; an in-place widening of the table row costs no line and sits well under the row pin.
- open_questions: empty. Acceptance notes: both notes (the index row; `review-checklist.md` has no cloud-routing item) are observations outside the declared surface; the second needs no line, because L178 sits beside the checklist pointer and the checklist's reader meets it first.

Check-runs on the head, re-read until none was in progress (last read 2026-10-26T19:08Z; last completion 2026-10-26T19:06Z): 44 runs — 26 success, 18 skipped, 0 failure, 0 in progress. Success includes Lint & Repo Gates, Lint · PM dispatch-gates, Lint · repo & tooling gates, Lint · docs & code guards, Lint · ESLint, Governed Surface Queue Guard, Check Changeset, TypeScript Type Check and its four lanes, Test Core, Dogfood Regression Gate, Check Documentation Links, Check PR Size, and the three PR-claim guards. The 18 skipped are matrix shards, opt-in harnesses and the UI lanes, none owed by a `.claude/**`-only diff.

Tier S: the owning seat lands through the queue on this PASS; this reviewer readied, armed and enqueued nothing.

## 席位核对 — ACCEPT · `domain:skills#2` · `session_01LqKsGyMNFwwnbF5FTAqyPn` · 2026-10-26T19:14Z

Seat review of record for #26121 on head `ff37d61c`, against GitHub, not the report's own account. Governed `.claude/**` PR, Tier S: the record that unlocks landing is the independent `## Contract review` at comment 6425062560 (`Served-tier: CONTRACT_REVIEW_TIER`, head `ff37d61c`, `VERDICT: PASS`, drafted by a reviewer other than the implementer — the in-session os-dev subagent). This seat adds the landing read, not a second contract read.

1. **Shape.** Draft, base `main`, `mergeable: true`; body line 1 `Fixes #26121`, no closing keyword beside any other card number; `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none`; `## 维护者速读(草稿)` present with 席位意见 empty. Files: `references/cross-repo-coordination.md` (two home lines added after the split-by-repo pair; the reader intro line and its blank retired to pay them), `references/execution-duties.md` (one pointer line under 〈复核〉), `.claude/agents/os-dev.md` (line 52 respelled in place, 120 → 114 bytes); +4/−3, all inside the claim's file surface; `SKILL.md` untouched. `check-governed-merges.mjs --pr 26286`: GOVERNED, Tier S (`.claude/**` ×3, no Tier H path), 7 changed lines. Labels `documentation`, `size/xs`, `skip-changeset` — right, `.claude/**` publishes nothing.
2. **Record, measured.** The reviewer read the two home lines against the maintainer's three quotes and the precedents' label shape (`domain:cloud` + `status:parked` + `repo:cloud`, provenance, criterion), found the actor (the seat), the three sources (report `open_questions`/`out_of_scope_findings`, review/landing findings) and the three prohibitions all said, with `Blocked-by:` reaching by reference from the line above; judged the retired intro line a legitimate payment (its readers and moments live verbatim in SKILL.md's 阶段细则索引 row; three sibling references already open without one; no gate pins it); walked the four respellings of `os-dev.md:52` and found none changes what a dev does (the positive definition 卡号或人 unchanged, `none` the one spelling across home, dev side and card, `cloud` an explicit sentinel, 该节 resolving to `## Acceptance notes`); confirmed post-stamped's `Carrier:` recogniser judges only vacant seat posts and is case-sensitive, so `carrier: cloud` collides with nothing. The seat re-read the diff and reads the same.
3. **Gates, pinned to head `ff37d61c`.** 44 check-runs, 26 success and 18 skipped, none red or pending — among them `Lint & Repo Gates` (ratchet 47/47, 188/188, 404/404, 319/319; id-lint), `TypeScript Type Check`, `Test Core`, `Governed Surface Queue Guard`, `Lint · PM dispatch-gates`, `Check Changeset`, `Check PR Size`, and all claim/close guards.
4. **维护者速读.** 这张 PR 把你 10-26 的三句话写进技能:开发中发现涉及 cloud 车道的事(dev 报告里的 open_questions / out_of_scope_findings、席位复核或落地时看到的),由席位立 cloud 车道卡,⛔ 不记而弃、不并进本仓 PR、不留 `carrier: none`;卡的形状照 server 席今天立的两张先例(`domain:cloud`+`status:parked`+`repo:cloud`、出处行、一行判据)。一处正文(多仓协调)、两处指针(执行席复核一行、dev 角色定义里 `carrier:` 一行就地改写,dev 遇 cloud 写 `carrier: cloud`)。为了放进多仓协调文件的行数天花板,删了开头一行「谁在何时读本文」的说明,它在 SKILL.md 阶段细则索引表里原样存在。无脚本、无门禁改动;回滚 = revert 两个提交。
5. **Accepted deviations.** (a) Branch `claude/project-thread-1r3slx` (the measured platform exception), the claim names it and the claim guards are green. (b) The seat's own hypothesis that `cross-repo-coordination.md` had headroom 4 was wrong (ceiling 47, not 51); the dev measured it and paid in-file — the right side. (c) The dev's "21 → 24" cloud-grep prose is off by one (20 → 24; the respelled `os-dev.md:52` is the fourth new hit); immaterial. (d) The `carrier: PR or person` wording in the JSON template at `os-dev.md` ~379 already disagreed with 卡号或人 on `main`; outside this diff.
6. **Carrier, not filed — 收班简报 items.** (i) SKILL.md 阶段细则索引 row for `cross-repo-coordination.md` does not yet name the review moment (a table row, widening costs no line). (ii) SKILL.md 「`domain:*` 只由分诊产出,两例外」 does not list the parked split that `cross-repo-coordination.md` and both precedents already practise. (iii) `scripts/pm/fleet-write`'s re-exec notice prints the proxy address from an environment variable into the local log (a loopback address, not a secret; the dev kept it off GitHub).
7. **Landing.** Tier S with a PASS record on the current head and every check green ⇒ the owning seat readies it and arms auto-merge through the relay (`pr_ready`, then `automerge_enable`), on the maintainer's standing word in the seat thread (2026-10-26: 「你按照 pm-dispatch 技能审核的pr都可以落地」), follows it to MERGED, and confirms on both the queue branch and `origin/main`.
